mapper.select: SELECT d.driver_contact, d.driver_birthdate, d.driver_region, d.created_at, d.driver_name, d.driver_idx, d.driver_img, a.admin_name, c.car_number, COUNT(l.car_number) AS count_log FROM tb_driver d LEFT JOIN tb_admin a ON d.admin_idx = a.admin_idx LEFT JOIN tb_car c ON d.driver_idx = c.driver_idx LEFT JOIN tb_log l ON l.car_number = c.car_number GROUP BY d.driver_idx, d.driver_contact, d.driver_birthdate, d.driver_region, d.created_at, a.admin_name, c.car_number
